content:
Overview

Rockhampton is a city in Queensland with a population of 80,665. Central Queensland’s beef capital with the Fitzroy River, Great Keppel Island, and historic architecture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
